text.description_html:
Thick Door Package for Hercular Single Cylinder Deadbolt, Mul-T-Lock PLK-HRCACC-THK-HD1

These kits are adjustable for installing Hercular Single Cylinder Deadbolts on doors that are between 2-1/16" and 3-1/4" inches thick.

This thick door installation kit includes extra long snap to fit bolts and 1.783" extended length tailpiece.
